:root{--bg:#e8eef2;--panel:#f6f9fb;--ink:#0f2233;--mute:#4d6273;--line:#b9c7d2;--sig:#0b7f7a;--warn:#b8780a;

@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#0c1822;--panel:#122433;--ink:#e6eef4;--mute:#9bb0bf;--line:#2a4256;--sig:#3ccfc6;--warn:#e6b04a}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#0c1822;--panel:#122433;--ink:#e6eef4;--mute:#9bb0bf;--line:#2a4256;--sig:#3ccfc6;--warn:#e6b04a}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);scroll-behavior:smooth}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:400 1rem/1.65 "IBM Plex Sans",system-ui,sans-serif}

a{color:inherit}
a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--sig);outline-offset:3px}
.wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.25rem}
nav{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:1.1rem 0;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap}

.hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr 1fr;gap:2.5rem;align-items:center;padding:3rem 0 4rem}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(2.4rem,6vw,4.2rem);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em}

.hero p{color:var(--mute);max-width:46ch;margin:0 0 1.6rem}
.btns{display:flex;gap:.75rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn{display:inline-block;padding:.75rem 1.25rem;border-radius:6px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:500;border:1.5px solid var(--ink)}
.btn.main{background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg)}
.btn:hover{border-color:var(--sig)}
.photo{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:1.5rem 1.5rem 0;max-width:420px;justify-self:center;width:100%;overflow:hidden}.photo img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
.topo{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:.75rem}
.topo svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.topo .cap{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--mute);margin:.5rem .25rem .1rem}
.ln{stroke:var(--line);stroke-width:2;fill:none}
.nd{fill:var(--bg);stroke:var(--ink);stroke-width:1.8}
.nd.hot{stroke:var(--sig)}
.tx{fill:var(--ink);font:500 11px "IBM Plex Sans",sans-serif;text-anchor:middle}
section{padding:3.5rem 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
section h2{font-size:clamp(1.7rem,3.5vw,2.3rem);margin-bottom:1.75rem}
.skills{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:2rem}
.skills h3{font-size:1.1rem;margin-bottom:.6rem;color:var(--sig)}
.skills ul,.proj ul,.certs{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.skills li{padding:.3rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--mute)}
.proj{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2.5rem}
.proj h3{font-size:1.5rem;margin-bottom:.8rem}
.proj p{color:var(--mute);margin:0 0 1rem}
.proj li{padding:.45rem 0 .45rem 1.2rem;position:relative;color:var(--mute)}
.proj li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:1.05rem;width:7px;height:7px;background:var(--sig);border-radius:50%}
.topo-fig{grid-column:1/-1;margin:1rem 0 0}
.topo-scroll{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;overflow:auto;max-height:80vh}
.topo-scroll img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
.topo-scroll.full img{width:1455px;max-width:none}
.topo-fig figcaption{color:var(--mute);font-size:.9rem;margin-top:.6rem}
.topo-fig button{background:none;border:0;padding:0;font:inherit;color:var(--sig);text-decoration:underline;cursor:pointer}
.tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.5rem;margin-top:1rem}
.tags span{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);padding:.2rem .7rem;border-radius:99px;font-size:.88rem}
.certs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:1rem}
.certs li{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:4px solid var(--sig);padding:1rem 1.1rem;border-radius:6px}
.certs small{display:block;color:var(--mute)}
.edu{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.edu p{margin:.3rem 0 0;color:var(--mute)}
.contact p{color:var(--mute);max-width:52ch;margin:0 0 1.4rem}
footer{padding:2rem 0 2.5rem;color:var(--mute);font-size:.9rem;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
@media (max-width:820px){.hero,.proj{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero{padding-top:1.5rem}}
</style>
</head>

<h3>BUILDING A SECURE NETWORK WITH HIGH AVAILABILITY USING CISCO TECHNOLOGY</h3>
<p>I designed and built a scalable network with routers, switches and firewalls. It stays up when a device fails and keeps traffic protected.</p>
<p>The result was better performance, reliability and business continuity.</p>
<div class="tags"><span>Cisco</span><span>HSRP / VRRP</span><span>ASA</span><span>IPS</span><span>VPN</span><span>VoIP</span></div>

<li>Designed and implemented the infrastructure: routers, switches and firewalls</li>
<li>Configured HSRP/VRRP, load balancing, Cisco ASA, IPS, VPN and secure VoIP</li>
<li>Monitored, tested and tuned performance, availability and security</li>
<li>Wrote the technical documentation and trained IT staff on operations</li>
</ul>
